## 1. Discrete Distributions

| | Bern(p) | Binom(n,p) | Geom(p) | Pois($\lambda$) | Disc Unif $\{1,\dots,n\}$ |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Range | {0,1} | {0,1,…,n} | {1,2,3,…} | {0,1,2,…} | {1,…,n} |
| PMF | $p^x(1-p)^{1-x}$ | $\binom{n}{k}p^k(1-p)^{n-k}$ | $(1-p)^{k-1}p$ | $e^{-\lambda}\frac{\lambda^k}{k!}$ | $\frac{1}{n}$ |
| E[X] | p | np | 1/p | $\lambda$ | $\frac{n+1}{2}$ |
| Var | p(1−p) | np(1−p) | (1−p)/p² | $\lambda$ | $\frac{n^2-1}{12}$ |
| MGF | $(1-p)+pe^t$ | $[(1-p)+pe^t]^n$ | $\frac{pe^t}{1-(1-p)e^t}$ | $e^{\lambda(e^t-1)}$ | $\frac{1}{n}\sum_{k=1}^n e^{tk}$ |

Binom = sum of n iid Bern(p) | Indicator: $I_A \sim \text{Bern}(P(A))$ |
Geom: memoryless (discrete) | $E[X] = \sum x \cdot P(X=x)$ | LOTUS: $E[g(X)] = \sum g(x) P(X=x)$
MGF domains: Geom $t<-\ln(1-p)$ | Bern/Binom/Pois/Disc Unif: all $t$ | General disc unif on $\{x_1,\dots,x_n\}$: $E[X]=\frac1n\sum x_i$

## 2. Variance & Linearity
$E[\sum a_i X_i] = \sum a_i E[X_i]$ | $E[aX+b] = aE[X]+b$
$\text{Var}(X) = E[X^2] - (E[X])^2$ | $E[X^2] = \text{Var}(X) + (E[X])^2$
$\text{Var}(aX + b) = a^2 \text{Var}(X)$
$\text{Var}(\sum a_i X_i) = \sum a_i^2 \text{Var}(X_i)$ **only when independent** | E is always linear, Var is not

## 3. Continuous RVs
$f(x) \ge 0$, $\int f(x)dx = 1$ (can be more than 1) | $P(X = a) = 0$
$F(x) = \int_{-\infty}^{x} f(t)dt = P(X \le x)$ | $f(x) = F'(x)$ | $P(a < X < b) = F(b) - F(a)$ | endpoints don't matter | 
Normalizing: $f(x) = c \cdot h(x)$, set $\int c \cdot h(x)dx = 1$ | LOTUS: $E[g(X)] = \int g(x) f(x)dx$
Quantiles: $P(X \le q_\alpha)=\alpha$ | if invertible, $q_\alpha = F^{-1}(\alpha)$ | Median $= q_{1/2}$ | IQR $= q_{3/4} - q_{1/4}$
Nonneg RVs: $E[X] = \int_0^\infty P(X > x)dx = \int_0^\infty [1-F(x)]dx$ (other E[X] way)

## 4. Continuous Distributions
**Uniform($a,b$):** Range $[a,b]$ | $f = \frac{1}{b-a}$ | $F = \frac{x-a}{b-a}$ | $E = \frac{a+b}{2}$ | Var $= \frac{(b-a)^2}{12}$

**Normal($\mu, \sigma^2$):** Range $\mathbb{R}$ | $f = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi\sigma^2}} \exp(-\frac{(x-\mu)^2}{2\sigma^2})$ | $E = \mu$ | Var $= \sigma^2$
$\quad Z = (X-\mu)/\sigma \sim N(0,1)$ | $P(a < X < b) = \Phi(\frac{b-\mu}{\sigma}) - \Phi(\frac{a-\mu}{\sigma})$ | $c = \mu + \sigma \Phi^{-1}(\alpha)$
$\quad aX + b \sim N(a\mu+b, a^2\sigma^2)$ (linear transform stays Normal) | 68-95-99.7 rule

**Exp($\beta$):** Range $[0,\infty)$ | $f = \beta e^{-\beta x}$ | $F = 1 - e^{-\beta x}$ | $P(X > x) = e^{-\beta x}$ | $E = 1/\beta$ | Var $= 1/\beta^2$
$\quad q_\alpha = -\frac{1}{\beta}\ln(1-\alpha)$ | Memoryless: $P(X > t+s|X > t) = P(X > s)$ | Exp $=$ Gamma$(1,\beta)$

**Gamma($\alpha, \beta$):** Range $(0,\infty)$ | $f = \frac{\beta^\alpha}{\Gamma(\alpha)} x^{\alpha-1} e^{-\beta x}$ | $E = \alpha/\beta$ | Var $= \alpha/\beta^2$ | $\alpha$ = shape, $\beta$ = rate

**Beta($a,b$):** Range $(0,1)$ | $f = \frac{\Gamma(a+b)}{\Gamma(a)\Gamma(b)}x^{a-1}(1-x)^{b-1}$ | **Gamma fn:** $\Gamma(a+1) = a\Gamma(a)$ | $\Gamma(n) = (n-1)!$ | $\Gamma(1/2) = \sqrt{\pi}$

## 5. Kernel recognition
$\int_0^\infty x^{\alpha-1} e^{-\beta x}dx = \frac{\Gamma(\alpha)}{\beta^\alpha}$ (gamma kernel: power $= \alpha-1$, rate $= \beta$)
$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \exp(-\frac{(x-\mu)^2}{2\sigma^2})dx = \sqrt{2\pi\sigma^2}$ (Gaussian kernel: complete the square)
Complete square: $-ax^2 + bx = -a(x - \frac{b}{2a})^2 + \frac{b^2}{4a}$

## 6. MGFs
$M_X(t) = E[e^{tX}]$ | $M(0) = 1$ | $M'(0) = E[X]$ | $M''(0) = E[X^2]$ | Var $= M''(0) - (M'(0))^2$
Same MGF = same dist | $M_{aX+b}(t) = e^{bt} M_X(at)$ | Indep: $M_{X+Y} = M_X \cdot M_Y$
Domains: Exp $M(t)=\frac{\beta}{\beta-t}$, $t<\beta$ | Gamma $M(t)=(\frac{\beta}{\beta-t})^\alpha$, $t<\beta$ | Normal/Pois: all $t$

## 7. Transformations
**CDF method:** (1) Range($Y$) (2) $F_Y(y) = P(g(X) \le y)$ (3) Solve for $X$, use $F_X$ (4) Differentiate
Step 2: isolate $X$ inside $F_X$: e.g. $P(2X+3 \le y) = P(X \le \frac{y-3}{2}) = F_X(\frac{y-3}{2})$. Then differentiate with chain rule.
Increasing $g$: inequality same | Decreasing $g$: flips (e.g. $P(1/X \le y) = P(X \ge 1/y) = 1-F_X(1/y)$)
**Monotone shortcut:** $f_Y = f_X(g^{-1}(y)) \cdot |(g^{-1})'(y)|$
Non-monotone ($Y = X^2$): use CDF method, $P(X^2 \le y) = P(-\sqrt{y} \le X \le \sqrt{y})$, simplifies if $X > 0$

## 8. Joint Distributions
Discrete joint: same formulas, but **sums replace integrals** | $p_X(x)=\sum_y p_{XY}(x,y)$ | $p_{X|Y}(x|y)=p_{XY}(x,y)/p_Y(y)$|
$f_X(x) = \int f_{XY}(x,y)dy$ (marginal) | $f_{X|Y}(x|y) = f_{XY}(x,y) / f_Y(y)$ (conditional)|
$f_{XY} = f_{Y|X} \cdot f_X = f_{X|Y} \cdot f_Y$ (decomposition) | $f_{X|Y}(x|y) = \frac{f_{Y|X}(y|x) f_X(x)}{f_Y(y)}$ (Bayes)|
Independence: $f_{XY} = f_X \cdot f_Y$ for all $(x,y)$ $\Leftrightarrow$ conditional = marginal|
Hierarchical: given $X \sim P_X$, $Y|X=x \sim P_{Y|X}$, joint $= f_{Y|X}(y|x) \cdot f_X(x)$|
$E[X|Y=y] = \int x f_{X|Y}(x|y)dx$ (function of $y$) | $E[g(X,Y)] = \iint g \cdot f_{XY} dxdy$|
If indep: $E[g_1(X) g_2(Y)] = E[g_1(X)] \cdot E[g_2(Y)]$ | **SKETCH JOINT RANGE FIRST**|
$0<x<y<\infty$: fix $y \to x \in [0,y]$; fix $x \to y \in [x,\infty)$ | $0<y<x<1$: fix $x \to y \in [0,x]$; fix $y \to x \in [y,1]$

## 9. Sums/Averages of IID RVs
$X_i$ iid, mean $\mu$, var $\sigma^2$, mgf $M(t)$ | $S_n = \sum X_i$ | $\bar{X}_n = S_n/n$
$S_n$: $E = n\mu$ | Var $= n\sigma^2$ | MGF $= M(t)^n$
$\bar{X}_n$: $E = \mu$ | Var $= \sigma^2/n$ | MGF $= M(t/n)^n$
Bern $\to$ Binom$(n,p)$ | Pois $\to$ Pois$(n\lambda)$ | Exp $\to$ Gamma$(n,\beta)$
Gamma$(\alpha,\beta) \to$ Gamma$(n\alpha, \beta)$ | $N(\mu,\sigma^2) \to N(n\mu, n\sigma^2)$, avg $N(\mu, \sigma^2/n)$

## 10. Reference & Tricks
$n=1$ raw = mean | $n=2$ central = var | $n=3$ std = skewness | $n=4$ std = kurtosis From $E[X^n]$
Skew: $0$ symm, $>0$ right tail, $<0$ left | $\sum r^k = 1/(1-r)$ | $e^x = \sum x^k/k!$ | $(x+y)^n = \sum \binom{n}{k} x^k y^{n-k}$
$\sum_{k=1}^n k = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}$ | $\sum_{k=1}^n k^2 = \frac{n(n+1)(2n+1)}{6}$ | use for disc unif mgf $\to$ mean/variance
Conditioning: $P(X=k|A)=\frac{P(X=k,\;A)}{P(A)}$ |
**Key pattern:** counting RV = sum of indicators → use linearity for E, independence for Var
**MGF exists = all moments finite** (not converse) | **same MGF = same dist** (same moments does NOT)
